name: DBS Bank
summary: Candidates report a HackerRank online test with coding problems and CS multiple-choice questions, then technical interviews that lean on Java, SQL, data structures and their own projects, and an HR or manager round. Graduate hires through Hack2Hire also report a team hackathon. Public coding detail is thin.

rounds.name: Online assessment
rounds.what: HackerRank test with coding problems plus multiple-choice questions on core CS subjects.

rounds.name: Hackathon (Hack2Hire graduate track)
rounds.what: Team build of a small web application or API over several hours, with mentors watching teamwork and contribution.

rounds.name: Technical interview
rounds.what: Data structures (arrays, trees, linked lists, sorting), OOP, OS and DBMS, plus questions about your projects.

rounds.name: HR or manager interview
rounds.what: Mostly non-technical: background, projects, teamwork and expectations.

tips: Expect Java, Spring and SQL questions next to standard data structures problems.
Prepare to walk through your own projects and your exact contribution.
In the Hack2Hire hackathon, mentors watch teamwork, so contribute visibly and help the team ship.
Read input bounds first and state your assumptions before coding.
